## Release — backlog-campaign v0.18.0

### ✨ What's new in v0.18.0

Minor release centred on **owner intent as enforceable state** and **UI work that cannot
skip design**. Owner rulings become a first-class, watermarked object every worker reads;
UI-flagged issues now pass an interpretation gate at plan time and a visual-evidence gate
at review time; and a recurring UX-coherence hunt kind audits whole-app journeys.

#### Owner rulings as first-class state

- **Owner-rulings ledger (ADR-020 companion object)** — `documentation/reference/product-principles.md`
  is scaffolded unconditionally at Phase 0 (skip-if-exists, gated by
  `docs_governance.companion_files`) and holds verbatim owner quotes with an active/superseded
  status. All workers read it.
- **`V-RULE-01` (BLOCK)** — a diff that violates a recorded active-status ruling is blocked,
  so a decision stated once in chat keeps binding later phases.
- **Ruling watermark + phase-gate re-validation (ADR-020)** — chat feedback intake forks
  **task vs ruling**, and a per-issue `rulings_checked_at` watermark in `queue.json` forces
  re-validation at phase gates. A ruling landing mid-flight no longer silently misses the
  issues already past handle.

#### UI work cannot skip design

- **Plan-time UI gate (ADR-017)** — a `route.ui: true`, non-`size:xs` issue must carry an
  approved `ui_gate` (mockup + interpretation block) in its plan frontmatter before
  implementation. Enforced as **`V-UI-01` (BLOCK)**; the issue parks on
  `awaiting-design-approval` until the owner signs off.
- **Visual evidence gate (ADR-018)** — UI-affecting PRs must declare `visual_evidence[]`
  captured at the configured `display_targets`. **`V-VIS-01` (BLOCK)** catches a silent
  skip; **`V-VIS-02` (WARN)** keeps a declared `capture_status: unavailable` visible rather
  than swallowed.
- **Spec-change gate — `V-SPEC-01` (BLOCK, repo-local)** — a diff that both touches a UI
  file and edits acceptance-criteria lines in a story catalog needs a
  `Spec-Change-Approved:` trailer. This closes spec-after-code, where review would verify
  code against criteria the same PR rewrote. `impl:`/`test:` traceability edits stay exempt.

#### Kaizen

- **`ux-coherence` hunt kind (ADR-019)** — a recurring whole-app journey and surface audit
  scored against `journeys.md` and the rulings ledger, with a `journeys.md` companion
  scaffold. Inert unless the campaign opts into `kaizen`.

#### Planner, reviewer & worker-JSON hygiene

- **Dist trees cite an SSOT** — planner and reviewer reference `scripts/lib/build/targets.ts`
  instead of hand-enumerating build-output trees in plan Touch-Paths, so a new target no
  longer silently falls outside plan scope.
- **`validateArrayOf` combinator** — worker-JSON validators share one array-of-objects
  field-validator; `validateHunterFindingsArray` migrated onto it.
- **Reviewer fixture wired into the suite** — `reviewer-complete-vspec-block-finding.json`
  now runs in `validate-worker-json.test.ts` rather than sitting unexercised.
- **Decision log** — PR #428/#430 decision records appended.
